# Model

[Project home](../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

The only runtime topology is articulated_girdle. Exact numerical mechanics are applied before the editable parameter overrides.

- [articulated girdle](articulated_girdle/README.md) — Body and joint topology with an articulated shoulder girdle, numerical mechanics and muscle data. Applied parameter overrides are stored separately in Model_Parameters.
- Optional local meshes: see [visual anatomy and redistribution notes](../README.md).
